custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'leg-plant interface'. AI often struggles with thin objects gripping other thin objects. Check if the legs physically wrap around the stem or just float on top. Also, verify if the 'blur' on the wing tip is consistent with the depth of field seen in the background leaves.
image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green vegetation. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is dark brown with distinct rows of small, pale-centered eyespots (ocelli). The body appears fuzzy and brown, matching the wings. One antenna is clearly visible with a clubbed tip. Several legs are visible gripping the plant stem.
